scenes.say: Every night, fans capture amazing moments at live shows. That content drives the music industry... and the people who shoot it earn nothing.
Meet Moo-so. It turns fan captures into income. Post your shots from the event, tag the artist, and choose how fans pay: unlock, pay what you want, or tips.
Artists decide. Fans can sell captures only of artists who opt in, and every event sets its own recording rules.

Now, sponsors fund reward pools with U.S.D.C. on Arc. The money sits in a smart contract, not with us. When the pool ends, it's split by real, server-verified watch time, and paid straight to each creator's wallet. Creators never pay gas.
Sponsors get proof they can trust. Every pool's attention report is published to Arkiv. Read-only, so no one can change it. Not even Moo-so.
Every creator gets a free E.N.S. name, like: shiv beats, dot, Moo-so app, dot, eeth. So anyone can tip them by name, from any wallet.
Fans create. Artists approve. Sponsors pay for real attention. Moo-so. Capture the moment, and earn from it.
